content.html:
MSDS

Material Safety Data Sheets

What a customs officer, a carrier and a retailer ask for: the sheet that says how the goods are to be handled, stored and transported. One sheet exists for every active SKU, and it travels with the consignment. The representative sheet below is published so you can check the format before you order.

A safety data sheet exists for every active SKU and is issued with the consignment — ask for the sheet for the SKU you ordered.

It is a record of the consignment, not an approval of the wording on a label for any market. Label approval is a separate exercise, and we help you map it for your target market.

Note: The sheet published below is issued in Chinese by the testing laboratory, because that is the version the carrier and the customs broker accept. An English version is issued per order — ask with your SKU and destination market.

Published sample

Jingwei Xiaozi · deodorizing liquid

A complete 16-section sheet. GHS classification: not a hazardous substance or mixture — no hazard pictogram, no signal word. Transport: not classified as dangerous goods under ADR/RID, IMDG and IATA-DGR. Appearance: pale yellow liquid, pH 5.0–7.5.

SiT testing laboratory · report SIT250402370103SF · issued 2025-04-09 · 6 pages
